system: zincblende InP, two-atom primitive cell: In at (0,0,0), P at (1/4,1/4,1/4) (crystal coordinates); PBE; SSSP 1.3 precision ultrasoft pseudopotentials In.pbe-dn-rrkjus_psl.0.2.2.UPF (4d in valence) and P.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF; fixed occupations; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 on 2 cores

request.kmesh: n of an n x n x n Monkhorst-Pack mesh
request.kshift: 0 Gamma-centred, 1 offset by half a step

cost_notes: Units per request; a cell is 'strained' when strain_zz != 0. ecutwfc_Ry = 65 doubles the cost and is available for scf, for dielectric up to kmesh 6 and for dfpt up to kmesh 4 (cubic cells only). Failed jobs stay charged.

result_units.force_constants_gamma_Ry_per_bohr2: 6x6 real matrix, rows/columns In x,y,z then P x,y,z
